scope.models: Local HTTP fixtures; no production model inference or credits. Captures confirm owned orchestrator and worker policy bodies reach the model.
scope.connectors: Controlled stdio fixture; real Appwrite services and arbitrary production MCP compatibility are not claimed.
scope.tui: Actual command palette, server selection and Off selection persisted through scoped RPC. Terminal pane capture is functional smoke, not a visual layout audit.
scope.startup: Compiled installer adopts private native startup ownership before host launch. Definitions remain in native config so env/file interpolation is retained; registry stores only original flags and fingerprints.
scope.roles: Activation does not expand tool authority. Advisor activation and coordinator external invocation are denied in the real harness.
scope.leases: Transient project connection leases are explicitly released or forgotten on service restart, not persisted.
scope.failures: Earlier raw-registry insertion lost native environment interpolation and runtime-only filtering allowed startup processes. Final metadata-only registry plus dormant native entries resolves both. One earlier legacy installer probe installed a host global ast-grep package despite HOME isolation; the exact task-created package was removed and active installer switched to managed provisioning. Final compiled installer QA confirms no global package-manager prefix created. Failed probes and cleanup evidence remain in ignored evidence.
scope.packaging: Clean archive runs exclude ambient host tool directories. TypeScript 5.9.3 and language server 5.0.0 are explicit disposable dependencies selected through trusted isolated user config.
scope.publication: Depends on PR #55. Repository Actions is enabled and momo CI active, but dispatch returns HTTP 422 and no run exists. CI and review remain external publication gates.

checks.resources: Serial probes and full suite; CPU affinity 0-3 and GOMAXPROCS=4. Full suite uses private executable tmpfs plus isolated XDG.
